# Readiness checklist

<!-- Generated by scripts/readiness.py render. Do not edit by hand. -->

A scored view of how ready each part of the platform is, assessed 2026-11-19 from `research/registry/readiness.json`. Scores are judgements tied to the evidence files listed per aspect, not measurements.

## Rubric

- 0 absent
- 1 ad hoc or one-off
- 2 partial
- 3 works for the current scope
- 4 robust and tested
- 5 production-grade

Importance is H, M or L, weighted 3, 2 and 1 in the weighted average. Half steps are allowed.
